vocabularies.definition: In a few words; summarized concisely.
vocabularies.example: In a few words; summarized concisely into the main takeaway.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Singkatnya, terangkum secara ringkas menjadi poin utama.
vocabularies.notes: 💡 Advance idiom for IELTS Speaking Part 3 when summarizing a viewpoint.

vocabularies.definition: To make something less severe, serious, or painful.
vocabularies.example: To make something bad or harmful less severe, serious, or painful.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Membuat sesuatu yang buruk atau berbahaya menjadi tidak terlalu parah.
vocabularies.notes: 💡 Advance equivalent of 'Reduce / Lessen'. Collocations: mitigate climate change, mitigate risks.

vocabularies.definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere at the same time.
vocabularies.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern daily life.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ponsel pintar telah menjadi hal yang ada di mana-mana dalam kehidupan sehari-hari modern.
vocabularies.notes: 💡 Advance equivalent of 'Everywhere / Common'. Band 8+ vocabulary to describe trends.

vocabularies.definition: Causing harm or damage; having a harmful effect.
vocabularies.example: Excessive screen time can have a detrimental effect on children's eyesight.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Waktu layar yang berlebihan dapat memiliki efek merugikan pada penglihatan anak-anak.
vocabularies.notes: 💡 Advance equivalent of 'Harmful / Bad'. Highly recommended for IELTS Task 2 essays.

vocabularies.definition: Causing or likely to cause harm.
vocabularies.example: Pollution is harmful to the environment.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Polusi berbahaya bagi lingkungan.
vocabularies.notes: 📌 Basic word (Band 5-6). Upgrade to 'Detrimental' or 'Damaging' for Band 7+ writing.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'There is no charge for entry, although donations are welcomed.'
vocabularies.example: There is free admission to the museum on weekdays.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Masuk museum gratis pada hari kerja biasa.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Local Museum (Part 2). Sering menjebak: kata 'donations' bukan berarti wajib bayar tiket.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Designed entirely by young people who attended the summer workshop.'
vocabularies.example: The artwork was created by students from the local college.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Karya seni tersebut dibuat oleh para siswa dari perguruan tinggi setempat.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Art Gallery (Part 2). 'Students' diparafrase menjadi 'young people who attended the course'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Open every day of the week except at the very start.'
vocabularies.example: The city library is closed on Mondays for staff maintenance.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Perpustakaan kota tutup pada hari Senin untuk pemeliharaan staf.
vocabularies.notes: Context: City Library (Part 2). Jebakan 'except at the very start of the week'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'All new members are strictly required to attend.'
vocabularies.example: Attendance at the orientation session is mandatory for all freshmen.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kehadiran pada sesi orientasi bersifat wajib bagi semua mahasiswa baru.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Campus Facility (Part 3). Sinonim: mandatory = compulsory = required = obliged to attend.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'The interior was fully refurbished and updated only last month.'
vocabularies.example: The sports centre was recently renovated with modern gym equipment.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pusat olahraga baru saja direnovasi dengan peralatan gym modern.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Sports Centre (Part 2). 'Renovated' diparafrase menjadi 'refurbished / modernised'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'There are only a handful of car spots available for visitors.'
vocabularies.example: Visitors are advised to take public transit due to limited parking space.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pengunjung disarankan menggunakan angkutan umum karena tempat parkir yang terbatas.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Town Hall (Part 2). 'Limited' diparafrase: 'only a handful of', 'restricted number'.

vocabularies.meaning: Membeli tiket terlebih dahulu / di muka
vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'You need to book your place online ahead of time.'
vocabularies.example: You should buy tickets in advance to secure a seat for the concert.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anda sebaiknya membeli tiket di muka untuk mengamankan kursi konser.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Theatre Box Office (Part 2). 'In advance' = 'ahead of time' = 'prior to arrival'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Ideal if you have never tried this activity before.'
vocabularies.example: This yoga class is suitable for beginners of all ages.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kelas yoga ini cocok untuk pemula dari segala usia.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Community Sports Club (Part 2). Menghadapi opsi jebakan 'for advanced athletes'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Parties of ten or more will receive a special discount.'
vocabularies.example: The museum offers a reduced price for school groups.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Museum menawarkan potongan harga khusus untuk rombongan sekolah.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Heritage Castle (Part 2). 'Groups' sering diparafrase menjadi 'parties of [x] or more'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'We initially planned to start this week, but it has been put off until December.'
vocabularies.example: The public lecture has been postponed until next month.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kuliah umum telah ditunda hingga bulan depan.
vocabularies.notes: Context: University Lecture Hall (Part 2/3). Distraktor waktu: 'put off / delayed'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Visitors must refrain from consuming snacks or drinks inside.'
vocabularies.example: Eating is not permitted in the computer lab.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Makan tidak diizinkan di dalam lab komputer.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Science Exhibition (Part 2). 'Not permitted' = 'must refrain from'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Right beside the main welcome desk as you walk through the doors.'
vocabularies.example: The cloakroom is located next to the reception counter.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ruang penitipan barang terletak di sebelah meja resepsionis.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Campus Information Desk (Part 2 Map). 'Next to' = 'adjacent to' = 'right beside'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Participants are expected to supply their own sports gear.'
vocabularies.example: You are required to bring your own equipment to the tennis workshop.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anda diwajibkan membawa peralatan sendiri ke lokakarya tenis.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Recreation Centre (Part 2). 'Supply own gear'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'We initially chose solar power, but we decided to switch to plastic recycling.'
vocabularies.example: The tutor approved our change of topic for the final presentation.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dosen pembimbing menyetujui perubahan topik kami untuk presentasi akhir.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Tutor Consultation (Part 3). Pola diskusi: ide awal disebut lalu sepakat berubah.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'The campus shuttle operates Monday through Friday, not over the weekend.'
vocabularies.example: The library reference room is available on weekdays only.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ruang referensi perpustakaan hanya tersedia pada hari kerja.
vocabularies.notes: Context: University Facility (Part 2). 'Monday through Friday, not over the weekend'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Situated directly adjoining the main dining hall on the ground floor.'
vocabularies.example: The student lounge is located adjacent to the cafeteria.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ruang santai mahasiswa terletak bersebelahan dengan kafetaria.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Campus Map (Part 2). 'Adjacent to' sering menggantikan 'next to / alongside'.

vocabularies.meaning: Penuh dipesan / tidak ada sisa tempat
vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'There are no vacancies remaining as every slot has been reserved.'
vocabularies.example: The evening seminar is fully booked, but morning sessions remain open.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Seminar malam sudah penuh dipesan, tetapi sesi pagi masih terbuka.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Conference Registration (Part 1/2). Jebakan ketersediaan tiket/tempat.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Tea, coffee, and biscuits will be provided at no extra cost.'
vocabularies.example: Guests can enjoy complimentary refreshments in the lobby before the show.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Para tamu dapat menikmati makanan ringan gratis di lobi sebelum pertunjukan.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Hotel / Event (Part 2). 'Complimentary' = 'free of charge'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'The initial data gathered before comprehensive laboratory testing was completed.'
vocabularies.example: The preliminary findings indicate a positive response to the new therapy.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Temuan awal menunjukkan respons positif terhadap terapi baru tersebut.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Academic Tutorial (Part 3/4). 'Preliminary' = 'initial / provisional'.

vocabularies.definition: IELTS Paraphrase: 'Every member of the committee was in total accord and voted in favor.'
vocabularies.example: The committee reached a unanimous decision to expand the scholarship fund.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Komite mencapai keputusan bulat untuk memperluas dana beasiswa.
vocabularies.notes: Context: Meeting Debrief (Part 3). Lawan kata: 'divided opinion / conflicting views'.

vocabularies.definition: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
vocabularies.example: Unplanned urbanization can exacerbate traffic congestion and air pollution.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Urbanisasi yang tidak terencana dapat memperparah kemacetan lalu lintas dan polusi udara.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 verb. Upgrade from 'make worse / worsen'. Collocations: exacerbate poverty, exacerbate inequality.

vocabularies.definition: Rapid increase in the number or amount of something.
vocabularies.example: The rapid proliferation of social media platforms has revolutionized communication.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Penyebaran pesat platform media sosial telah merevolusi cara komunikasi.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 noun. Collocations: proliferation of digital media, nuclear proliferation.

vocabularies.definition: A noticeable and usually unfair difference between people or things.
vocabularies.example: Growing economic disparity between rural and urban regions requires policy intervention.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kesenjangan ekonomi yang meningkat antara pedesaan dan perkotaan membutuhkan intervensi kebijakan.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ word. Upgrade from 'gap / difference'. Collocations: income disparity, gender disparity.

vocabularies.definition: Absolutely necessary; essential.
vocabularies.example: Critical thinking skills are indispensable in the modern knowledge-based economy.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Keterampilan berpikir kritis sangat diperlukan dalam ekonomi berbasis pengetahuan modern.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 adjective. Upgrade from 'very important / essential'. Collocation: play an indispensable role.

vocabularies.definition: To provide evidence to support or prove the truth of an assertion.
vocabularies.example: Researchers must substantiate their hypotheses with rigorous empirical data.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Para peneliti harus membuktikan hipotesis mereka dengan data empiris yang ketat.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.5 academic verb. Upgrade from 'prove / back up'. Collocations: substantiate a claim/finding.

vocabularies.definition: Of vital importance; crucial.
vocabularies.example: It is imperative that world leaders reach a binding agreement on carbon reduction.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sangat mendesak bagi para pemimpin dunia untuk mencapai perjanjian yang mengikat mengenai pengurangan karbon.
vocabularies.notes: Sentence pattern: 'It is imperative that [subject] + [infinitive]'.

vocabularies.meaning: Masuk akal / dapat dibayangkan atau dipikirkan
vocabularies.definition: Capable of being imagined or grasped mentally; plausible.
vocabularies.example: Scientists have proposed several conceivable solutions to clean plastic debris from oceans.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Para ilmuwan telah mengajukan beberapa solusi masuk akal untuk membersihkan sampah plastik dari lautan.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ word. Upgrade from 'imaginable / believable'. Collocations: conceivable alternative, conceivable explanation.

vocabularies.definition: Complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
vocabularies.example: A comprehensive educational reform must address curriculum design and teacher training.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Reformasi pendidikan yang komprehensif harus mencakup perancangan kurikulum dan pelatihan guru.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ adjective. Collocations: comprehensive strategy, comprehensive study.

vocabularies.definition: Widespread in a particular area or at a particular time.
vocabularies.example: Sedentary lifestyles are increasingly prevalent among office workers.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Gaya hidup kurang gerak semakin lazim terjadi di kalangan pekerja kantoran.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ word. Upgrade from 'common / widespread'. Collocation: widely prevalent.

vocabularies.definition: A lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts.
vocabularies.example: There is a noticeable discrepancy between reported corporate profits and tax payments.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Ada ketidakcocokan mencolok antara laba perusahaan yang dilaporkan dan pembayaran pajak.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 noun. Frequently tested in Academic Reading & Task 1 comparisons.

vocabularies.definition: To begin or start something formal or official.
vocabularies.example: Construction on the new public transit network is scheduled to commence next spring.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pembangunan jaringan transportasi umum baru dijadwalkan akan dimulai musim semi mendatang.
vocabularies.notes: Formal register equivalent of 'start / begin'.

vocabularies.definition: Put a decision, plan, agreement, etc. into effect.
vocabularies.example: Governments must implement stricter penalties for illegal logging.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pemerintah harus menerapkan hukuman yang lebih berat bagi pembalakan liar.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.0 standard academic verb. Collocations: implement policy, implement measures.

vocabularies.definition: Preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable.
vocabularies.example: Severe droughts can have adverse effects on national agricultural yields.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kekeringan parah dapat menimbulkan efek merugikan pada hasil panen pertanian nasional.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ word. Collocations: adverse impact, adverse weather conditions.

vocabularies.definition: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without exhausting natural resources.
vocabularies.example: Investing in renewable energy is essential for sustainable economic growth.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Berinvestasi pada energi terbarukan sangat penting untuk pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkelanjutan.
vocabularies.notes: Essential IELTS vocabulary for all Environmental topics. Collocations: sustainable development, sustainable practices.

vocabularies.definition: Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
vocabularies.example: There was a substantial rise in consumer spending following the tax reduction.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Terdapat kenaikan signifikan dalam pengeluaran konsumen setelah pemotongan pajak.
vocabularies.notes: Key Task 1 & Task 2 descriptor. Upgrade from 'big / a lot'.

vocabularies.definition: Disagreement, typically when prolonged, public, and heated.
vocabularies.example: The introduction of artificial intelligence in grading has sparked considerable controversy.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Penerapan kecerdasan buatan dalam penilaian ujian telah memicu kontroversi besar.
vocabularies.notes: Ideal for Writing Task 2 introductions: 'The issue of ... has ignited intense controversy.'

vocabularies.definition: Tending to be different or develop in different directions.
vocabularies.example: Economists hold divergent opinions on the long-term benefits of globalization.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Para ekonom memiliki pandangan yang berbeda mengenai manfaat jangka panjang globalisasi.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 adjective. Collocations: divergent views, divergent paths.

vocabularies.definition: Decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something.
vocabularies.example: Early childhood education plays a crucial role in cognitive development.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pendidikan anak usia dini memainkan peran krusial dalam perkembangan kognitif.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.0 upgrade from 'important'. Collocation: play a crucial role in.

vocabularies.definition: Possible to do easily or conveniently; practical.
vocabularies.example: Solar power is now a commercially feasible alternative to fossil fuels.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Tenaga surya kini menjadi alternatif yang layak secara komersial terhadap bahan bakar fosil.
vocabularies.notes: Collocations: economically feasible, practically feasible.

vocabularies.definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations.
vocabularies.example: Policymakers need to take a pragmatic approach rather than relying solely on idealistic models.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pembuat kebijakan perlu mengambil pendekatan pragmatis daripada hanya mengandalkan model idealis.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 word. Collocation: adopt a pragmatic approach.

vocabularies.definition: Never done or known before.
vocabularies.example: The healthcare sector faced unprecedented pressure during the global pandemic.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sektor kesehatan menghadapi tekanan yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya selama pandemi global.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 adjective. Collocations: unprecedented growth, unprecedented crisis.

vocabularies.definition: Involving or causing sudden great damage or suffering.
vocabularies.example: Failure to address climate change could result in catastrophic sea-level rise.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kegagalan mengatasi perubahan iklim dapat mengakibatkan kenaikan permukaan air laut yang membawa malapetaka.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ word. Upgrade from 'very terrible / disastrous'.

vocabularies.definition: Become progressively worse.
vocabularies.example: Air quality in major metropolitan areas continues to deteriorate year by year.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kualitas udara di wilayah metropolitan utama terus memburuk dari tahun ke tahun.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ verb. Upgrade from 'get worse'.

vocabularies.definition: Encourage the development of something, especially something desirable.
vocabularies.example: Schools should foster an environment that encourages independent inquiry and creativity.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sekolah harus membina lingkungan yang mendorong penyelidikan mandiri dan kreativitas.
vocabularies.notes: Band 7.5+ verb. Collocations: foster innovation, foster cooperation.

vocabularies.definition: A person or thing that held a job or office before the current holder, or an earlier model.
vocabularies.example: The latest electric vehicle model has double the driving range of its predecessor.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Model kendaraan listrik terbaru memiliki jarak tempuh dua kali lipat dibanding pendahulunya.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 academic noun.

vocabularies.meaning: Pedang bermata dua / ada plus minusnya
vocabularies.definition: Something that has both advantages and disadvantages.
vocabularies.example: Social media is a double-edged sword; it connects people globally but also fuels anxiety.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Media sosial adalah pedang bermata dua; menghubungkan orang secara global tetapi juga memicu kecemasan.
vocabularies.notes: Very versatile idiom for IELTS Speaking Part 3 and Writing Task 2.

vocabularies.word: Every cloud has a silver lining
vocabularies.meaning: Selalu ada hikmah di balik setiap musibah
vocabularies.definition: Every difficult or sad situation has a positive aspect to it.
vocabularies.example: Losing that job was stressful, but every cloud has a silver lining as it led to my own business.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kehilangan pekerjaan itu menegangkan, tetapi selalu ada hikmahnya karena menuntun saya mendirikan bisnis sendiri.
vocabularies.notes: Perfect for Speaking Part 2 stories about overcoming a challenge.

vocabularies.definition: Very rarely; almost never.
vocabularies.example: Because I live so far from my hometown, I only get to visit my relatives once in a blue moon.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Karena saya tinggal sangat jauh dari kampung halaman, saya hanya jarang sekali bisa mengunjungi kerabat.
vocabularies.notes: Natural frequency idiom to replace 'rarely' in Speaking Part 1.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling unhappy, depressed, or gloomy.
vocabularies.example: He was down in the dumps after failing his driving test on the first attempt.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dia merasa sedih setelah gagal dalam tes mengemudi pada percobaan pertama.
vocabularies.notes: Idiom for expressing mood and feelings in Speaking.

vocabularies.word: Cost an arm and a leg
vocabularies.definition: To be extremely expensive.
vocabularies.example: Renting a modern apartment in the city center costs an arm and a leg nowadays.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Menyewa apartemen modern di pusat kota sangat mahal harganya saat ini.
vocabularies.notes: Natural colloquial idiom for money, housing, and shopping topics.

vocabularies.word: Hit the nail on the head
vocabularies.definition: To state the exact truth; to describe precisely what is causing a situation.
vocabularies.example: My professor hit the nail on the head when she analyzed the root cause of the market crash.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dosen saya tepat sasaran ketika menganalisis akar penyebab anjloknya pasar.
vocabularies.notes: Use when agreeing with a statement in Speaking Part 3.

vocabularies.meaning: Belajar atau bekerja hingga larut malam
vocabularies.definition: To work or study late into the night.
vocabularies.example: I had to burn the midnight oil for several weeks before sitting for my IELTS examination.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Saya harus belajar lembur hingga larut malam selama beberapa minggu sebelum mengikuti ujian IELTS.
vocabularies.notes: Very common in student & study experience questions.

vocabularies.definition: Extremely pleased, happy, and thrilled.
vocabularies.example: She was over the moon when she discovered she had attained a Band 8.5 overall.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dia sangat gembira ketika mengetahui bahwa dia meraih skor Band 8.5 secara keseluruhan.
vocabularies.notes: Great for describing personal achievements in Part 2.

vocabularies.definition: At a point where an important decision must be made.
vocabularies.example: After graduation, I felt at the crossroads between pursuing a master's degree and starting a job.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Setelah lulus, saya merasa di persimpangan antara melanjutkan S2 atau mulai bekerja.
vocabularies.notes: Great for life transitions and decisions in Part 2.

vocabularies.word: Take it with a grain of salt
vocabularies.meaning: Tidak langsung percaya begitu saja / skeptis sehat
vocabularies.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt wɪð ə ɡreɪn ɒv sɔːlt/
vocabularies.definition: To understand that something is likely to be untrue or exaggerated.
vocabularies.example: You should take consumer reviews on internet forums with a grain of salt.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anda sebaiknya tidak langsung mempercayai ulasan konsumen di forum internet begitu saja.
vocabularies.notes: Demonstrates critical thinking in Speaking Part 3 questions about advertising and media.

vocabularies.definition: To agree fully with someone on an issue.
vocabularies.example: My business partner and I rarely saw eye to eye regarding marketing strategies.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Rekan bisnis saya dan saya jarang sependapat mengenai strategi pemasaran.
vocabularies.notes: Common in teamwork and conflict resolution topics.

vocabularies.definition: To expand one's knowledge, experience, or perspective.
vocabularies.example: Studying abroad allows young adults to broaden their horizons and encounter diverse cultures.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kuliah di luar negeri memungkinkan generasi muda memperluas wawasan mereka dan mengenal beragam budaya.
vocabularies.notes: Essential collocation for travel, education, and foreign language topics.

vocabularies.word: Step out of one's comfort zone
vocabularies.meaning: Keluar dari zona nyaman demi perkembangan diri
vocabularies.definition: To do things that you do not feel comfortable doing or that are unfamiliar.
vocabularies.example: Public speaking forced me to step out of my comfort zone and gain immense self-confidence.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Berbicara di depan umum memaksa saya keluar dari zona nyaman dan mendapatkan rasa percaya diri yang besar.
vocabularies.notes: High-scoring phrase for personal growth and challenges in Part 2.

vocabularies.definition: Completely unexpectedly; without prior notice.
vocabularies.example: Out of the blue, my childhood friend called me to announce his wedding.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Tiba-tiba tanpa diduga, sahabat masa kecil saya menelepon untuk mengabarkan pernikahannya.
vocabularies.notes: Excellent narrative transition for Speaking Part 2 storytelling.

vocabularies.definition: An apparent misfortune that eventually has good results.
vocabularies.example: Failing to secure the scholarship initially turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Gagal mendapatkan beasiswa pada awalnya ternyata merupakan berkah tersembunyi.
vocabularies.notes: Classic idiom for reflections and lessons learned.

vocabularies.meaning: Dalam suka maupun duka / setia selalu
vocabularies.definition: Under all conditions, no matter how challenging or difficult.
vocabularies.example: True friends will stand by you through thick and thin.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sahabat sejati akan selalu berdiri di sampingmu dalam suka maupun duka.
vocabularies.notes: Ideal for describing friendship, family, and relationships.

vocabularies.definition: Something that warrants serious consideration or reflection.
vocabularies.example: The documentary on marine conservation provided plenty of food for thought.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Dokumenter tentang konservasi laut tersebut memberikan banyak bahan renungan mendalam.
vocabularies.notes: Great for concluding Speaking Part 3 answers.

vocabularies.definition: To force yourself to do something unpleasant or difficult that you have been hesitating to do.
vocabularies.example: I decided to bite the bullet and invest my savings into learning web development.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Saya memutuskan untuk memberanikan diri dan menginvestasikan tabungan saya untuk belajar pengembangan web.
vocabularies.notes: Action-oriented idiom showing determination.

vocabularies.definition: To hope that someone will be successful or that something good will happen.
vocabularies.example: We submitted our university applications and are keeping our fingers crossed.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kami telah mengirimkan pendaftaran universitas dan berharap mendapatkan hasil yang terbaik.
vocabularies.notes: Friendly conversational idiom for hopes and future outcomes.

vocabularies.definition: Uncertain or unresolved; not yet decided.
vocabularies.example: My vacation plans are still up in the air until my flight booking is confirmed.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Rencana liburan saya masih belum pasti sampai pemesanan tiket penerbangan dikonfirmasi.
vocabularies.notes: Great for questions about upcoming plans or schedules.

vocabularies.definition: To do or say something that makes people feel more relaxed and comfortable in a social setting.
vocabularies.example: Sharing a light joke is an effective way to break the ice with new colleagues.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Berbagi lelucon ringan adalah cara ampuh untuk mencairkan suasana dengan rekan kerja baru.
vocabularies.notes: Social skills and workplace topics.

vocabularies.definition: To experience a sudden, very steep and large increase.
vocabularies.example: Online retail sales surged dramatically over the holiday quarter.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Penjualan ritel online melonjak drastis sepanjang kuartal liburan.
vocabularies.notes: Crucial Task 1 trend verb-adverb collocation. Upgrade from 'increase quickly'.

vocabularies.definition: To fall or drop very rapidly from a high level.
vocabularies.example: International tourist arrivals plummeted sharply during the pandemic lockdowns.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kedatangan turis internasional anjlok drastis selama masa karantina wilayah pandemi.
vocabularies.notes: Crucial Task 1 downward trend collocation. Upgrade from 'decrease a lot'.

vocabularies.definition: To change continually and irregularly with wide oscillations.
vocabularies.example: Crude oil prices fluctuated wildly between January and August.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Harga minyak mentah berfluktuasi tidak menentu antara bulan Januari dan Agustus.
vocabularies.notes: Essential Task 1 trend descriptor for erratic graphs.

vocabularies.definition: To reach a state or level where there is little or no further change.
vocabularies.example: Renewable energy production is projected to plateau at 45% by 2035.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Produksi energi terbarukan diproyeksikan akan mendatar di angka 45% pada tahun 2035.
vocabularies.notes: Task 1 leveling-off verb.

vocabularies.definition: Used to emphasize how completely different one thing is from another.
vocabularies.example: In stark contrast to male counterparts, female participation in engineering remained below 15%.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sangat berbanding terbalik dengan rekan pria, partisipasi wanita di bidang teknik tetap di bawah 15%.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 comparative transition for Writing Task 1 and Task 2.

vocabularies.definition: An overwhelming proportion (usually greater than 75-80%).
vocabularies.example: The vast majority of survey respondents favored flexible remote work arrangements.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Mayoritas mutlak responden survei mendukung pengaturan kerja jarak jauh yang fleksibel.
vocabularies.notes: Task 1 & Task 2 proportion phrase.

vocabularies.meaning: Sebagian kecil yang sangat tidak signifikan
vocabularies.definition: A very tiny proportion that is unimportant and can be disregarded.
vocabularies.example: Public expenditure on artistic cultural heritage accounts for a negligible fraction of the budget.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pengeluaran publik untuk warisan budaya seni hanya mencakup sebagian kecil yang tidak signifikan dari anggaran.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 academic proportion phrase for Task 1 & Task 2.

vocabularies.definition: Introducing a statement or idea that reverses or contrasts with one that has just been made.
vocabularies.example: High levels of physical activity improve cardiovascular health; conversely, prolonged inactivity degrades it.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Tingkat aktivitas fisik yang tinggi meningkatkan kesehatan kardiovaskular; sebaliknya, kurang bergerak yang berkepanjangan memperburuknya.
vocabularies.notes: High-scoring transitional linker for paragraph balance.

vocabularies.definition: In spite of; despite.
vocabularies.example: Notwithstanding the economic slowdown, consumer confidence stayed resilient.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Terlepas dari perlambatan ekonomi, kepercayaan konsumen tetap bertahan tangguh.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.5 preposition and linker. Formal equivalent of 'despite'.

vocabularies.definition: Deep, far-reaching effects or consequences.
vocabularies.example: The widespread automation of factory work carries profound implications for the labor market.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Otomatisasi pabrik yang meluas membawa dampak yang sangat mendalam bagi pasar tenaga kerja.
vocabularies.notes: Powerful collocation for essay conclusions in Writing Task 2.

vocabularies.meaning: Alternatif pilihan yang realistis dan efektif
vocabularies.definition: A practical and capable option that can succeed.
vocabularies.example: High-speed rail is considered the most viable alternative to short-haul domestic flights.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kereta cepat dianggap sebagai alternatif paling layak pengganti penerbangan domestik jarak pendek.
vocabularies.notes: High-yield solution phrase in problem-solution essays.

vocabularies.definition: Increasing force or burden that builds up steadily.
vocabularies.example: Hospitals are under mounting pressure due to an aging population and staff shortages.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Rumah sakit berada di bawah tekanan yang semakin meningkat akibat populasi lansia dan kekurangan staf.
vocabularies.notes: Descriptive collocation for social, economic, and medical challenges.

vocabularies.definition: A critical moment of decision or change with lasting historical effects.
vocabularies.example: The invention of the internet marked a pivotal turning point in human civilization.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Penemuan internet menandai titik balik krusial dalam peradaban manusia.
vocabularies.notes: High-impact phrase for essay bodies.

vocabularies.meaning: Sudut pandang menyeluruh dari semua sisi
vocabularies.definition: Viewing something by considering whole systems rather than just individual parts.
vocabularies.example: Urban planners must adopt a holistic perspective that integrates transport, green spaces, and affordable housing.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Perencana kota harus mengambil sudut pandang holistik yang mengintegrasikan transportasi, ruang hijau, dan perumahan terjangkau.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.5 phrase for concluding discussion and recommendation essays.

vocabularies.meaning: Pergeseran paradigma / perubahan pola pikir mendasar
vocabularies.definition: A fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions.
vocabularies.example: The transition to electric mobility represents a profound paradigm shift in the automotive industry.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Transisi menuju mobilitas listrik mencerminkan pergeseran paradigma mendalam dalam industri otomotif.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.5 phrase. Collocation: represent a paradigm shift.

vocabularies.meaning: Kemampuan kognitif / daya pikir dan nalar
vocabularies.definition: Mental capabilities including reasoning, memory, problem-solving, and attention.
vocabularies.example: Bilingualism has been shown to enhance cognitive ability throughout a person's lifespan.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Kemampuan dwibahasa telah terbukti meningkatkan kemampuan kognitif sepanjang hidup seseorang.
vocabularies.notes: Essential academic topic collocation for psychology and education essays.

vocabularies.meaning: Motivasi dari dalam diri / minat murni
vocabularies.definition: Behavior driven by internal rewards rather than external incentives.
vocabularies.example: Students who cultivate intrinsic motivation tend to achieve greater academic longevity.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Siswa yang menumbuhkan motivasi dari dalam diri cenderung mencapai keberhasilan akademis yang lebih tahan lama.
vocabularies.notes: Opposite: 'extrinsic motivation' (money, grades).

vocabularies.definition: The protection and management of species and biological ecosystems.
vocabularies.example: Biodiversity conservation is critical to maintaining global ecological equilibrium.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pelestarian keanekaragaman hayati sangat penting untuk menjaga keseimbangan ekologis global.
vocabularies.notes: High-scoring phrase for Environmental Task 2 essays.

vocabularies.meaning: Jejak karbon / jumlah emisi gas rumah kaca
vocabularies.definition: The total amount of greenhouse gases generated by human actions and lifestyle.
vocabularies.example: Individuals can shrink their carbon footprint by adopting plant-based diets and carpooling.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Individu dapat memperkecil jejak karbon mereka dengan menerapkan pola makan nabati dan berbagi tumpangan kendaraan.
vocabularies.notes: Collocations: reduce/shrink carbon footprint.

vocabularies.definition: The strength of relationships and the sense of solidarity among members of a community.
vocabularies.example: Community centers play a vital role in strengthening social cohesion in diverse neighborhoods.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pusat kegiatan masyarakat memainkan peran penting dalam memperkuat kerekatan sosial di lingkungan yang majemuk.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 sociological term for community and harmony essays.

vocabularies.definition: The traditions, monuments, objects, and culture inherited from past generations.
vocabularies.example: Governments have a moral duty to preserve ancient architectural monuments as cultural heritage.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pemerintah memiliki kewajiban moral untuk melestarikan monumen arsitektur kuno sebagai warisan budaya.
vocabularies.notes: Key topic in tourism, globalization, and history questions.

vocabularies.meaning: Pertumbuhan berlipat ganda / luar biasa pesat
vocabularies.definition: Extremely rapid increase in size or extent.
vocabularies.example: The artificial intelligence sector has experienced exponential growth over the past decade.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Sektor kecerdasan buatan telah mengalami pertumbuhan luar biasa pesat selama dekade terakhir.
vocabularies.notes: Collocation: undergo/experience exponential growth.

vocabularies.definition: An economic and sociological combined total measure of a person's work experience and economic position.
vocabularies.example: Children from lower socioeconomic status backgrounds often face systemic educational hurdles.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Anak-anak dari latar belakang status sosial ekonomi rendah sering menghadapi rintangan pendidikan sistemis.
vocabularies.notes: Formal academic term replacing 'poor / rich background'.

vocabularies.definition: To motivate or encourage someone to do something, typically with financial or tangible rewards.
vocabularies.example: Tax rebates can effectively incentivize companies to invest in clean energy technology.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Keringanan pajak dapat secara efektif mendorong perusahaan untuk berinvestasi pada teknologi energi bersih.
vocabularies.notes: High-scoring verb for policy solutions.

vocabularies.meaning: Penelitian berbasis fakta dan bukti nyata
vocabularies.definition: Research based on observed and measured phenomena and derives knowledge from actual experience rather than theory.
vocabularies.example: Policy recommendations must be anchored in empirical research rather than political ideology.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Rekomendasi kebijakan harus didasarkan pada penelitian empiris alih-alih ideologi politik.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 academic collocation.

vocabularies.definition: Support financially, typically by paying part of the cost from public funds.
vocabularies.example: Many experts argue that the state should heavily subsidize public transport to curb urban traffic.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Banyak pakar berpendapat bahwa negara harus memberikan subsidi besar untuk transportasi umum guna menekan kemacetan kota.
vocabularies.notes: Essential government action verb.

vocabularies.meaning: Meresap luas / merambah ke segala lini
vocabularies.definition: Spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people, especially of an unwelcome influence.
vocabularies.example: The pervasive influence of consumer advertising shapes dietary habits from an early age.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Pengaruh luas dari iklan konsumen membentuk kebiasaan makan sejak usia dini.
vocabularies.notes: Band 8.0 adjective. Collocations: pervasive influence, pervasive problem.

vocabularies.meaning: Keadaan yang meringankan kesalahan atau sanksi
vocabularies.definition: Conditions or happenings which do not excuse an offense, but which may be considered as reasons for reducing punishment.
vocabularies.example: The judge took into account several mitigating circumstances before determining the final verdict.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Hakim mempertimbangkan beberapa keadaan yang meringankan sebelum menentukan putusan akhir.
vocabularies.notes: Legal and crime essay collocation.

vocabularies.definition: A period of education that is required of all people and is imposed by government law.
vocabularies.example: Extending compulsory education to the age of eighteen has contributed to lower juvenile crime rates.
vocabularies.exampleTranslation: Memperpanjang wajib belajar hingga usia delapan belas tahun telah berkontribusi pada penurunan tingkat kejahatan remaja.
vocabularies.notes: Basic topic keyword. Synonym of 'mandatory schooling'.
